annotations.title: Get funnel, overview or cohort analytics

description: This app's real numbers. `overview` gives headline metrics (users, trials, trial→paid rate, events by name, cancel reasons, 14-day activity). `funnel` gives the ordered conversion funnel with per-step drop-off. `cohorts` compares behaviour across billing outcomes — what converted users did that cancelled users didn't. Below ~100 users in a step the sample is too small to read. `stores` splits paying users, purchases and revenue by App Store / Google Play / web and by storefront country (last 28 days).
name: get_analytics
